audit.why: Qiyana-favored lane at every stage (50.93% WR, 968 games, packet chart Qiyana on all 7 rows): he is immobile, his peel is a charged W taunt and one E dash, and lethality damage slips his magic shield. TRICKY tag reflects his AoE taunt punishing misplayed engages, not lane state.

Spikes accurate: early tempo control, level 6 all-in beats his self-peel with the taunt baited (his R is a roam tool, not a 1v1 answer), first-item lethality punches through early tank stats, late he gets tanky but you stay favored by flanking carries.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0] says 'his W charge and E taunt' — the taunt is Shield of Durand (W); Justice Punch (E) is the dash knockup. Galio's Colossal Smash (P) auto-reset burst tell never stated. Cooldowns field had no numbers. Two copy-paste-bleed bullets. Full chart row 6 said Galio while content win[6], the packet and all prose say Qiyana stays favored.
audit.why: Kit: W Shield of Durand 18s rank 1 (taunt + shield flag), E Justice Punch 11s rank 1 / 7s max (dash + knockup), R Hero's Entrance 180s global, P autoReset flag. missingInteractions flags the auto-reset tell and the R displacement race.
audit.corrected: W/E roles corrected in wants.you[0]; auto-reset tell folded into spikes[0].text; real cooldowns into breakdown.cooldowns; phases[6].side aligned to Qiyana.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Terrashape (element swap) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch (E): matchup-defining — 11s at rank 1, 7s max. His dash knockup; he has no engage while it is down. - Shield of Durand (W) is 18s: with it spent his all-in maths collapses. - The 120s ult answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: His E charges in a straight line — kite it around a wall corner and your R stun turns his own engage into your setup.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: Past your wall his 18s W taunt and E knockup are loaded — the chase ends with you taunted under his tower.

edits.before: Trade when his W charge and E taunt are on cooldown
edits.after: Trade when his W taunt and E dash are on cooldown

edits.before: You out-tempo him early. Galio is slow, immobile and pushes with Winds of War (Q); punish the wave he shoves by W-E-Q trading when his Shield of Durand (W) charge and E taunt are down. Build lethality so a chunk of your damage is physical and bypasses his magic-damage-reduction shield. Deny his roam priority with your own brush-Q camo flanks.
edits.after: You out-tempo him early. Galio is slow, immobile and pushes with Winds of War (Q); punish the wave he shoves by W-E-Q trading when his Shield of Durand (W) taunt and E dash are down. Build lethality so your damage is physical and bypasses his magic shield. His trades open with Colossal Smash — step back on the wind-up, and deny his roams with brush-Q camo flanks.
